entries.title: The Automation panel says how many automations are active and how many are paused
entries.body: The Automation panel's header now reads, for example, "1 active · 2 paused" instead of "3 automations". It changes as you pause or resume an automation, and leaves out the paused count when nothing is paused.

picture.alt: The Tasks panel's header reading "0 waiting · 1 working" above the Automation panel's header reading "1 active · 2 paused"
